news.title: Saint Louis University Hosting Screening of Refugee Student's Film
news.summary_en: Saint Louis University will host a screening of a film directed by Koang Simon Thot, a senior undergraduate student and resident of Kakuma refugee camp in Kenya where he pursues his degree remotely. Thot's 15-minute fictional film short, "Destiny Can Be chosen, Fate Cannot,” will be screened on Thursday Oct. 29.

news.title: With a $4.1 Million Agreement, Saint Louis University's Geospatial Center Will Train Federal Workforce
news.summary_en: Saint Louis University's Geospatial Center has been awarded a Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) from the federal government's GEOINT Learning Through Academic Program (GLAP) to develop training for the geospatial sciences.

news.title: SLU’s William L. Clay, Sr. Institute of Civic Engagement and Economic Justice to Hold Community Symposium
news.summary_en: Saint Louis University’s William L. Clay Sr. Institute of Civic Engagement and Economic Justice will host a community and civic engagement symposium on Wednesday, Nov. 11.
